emotional_tone: Elite athleticism, precision, command-center focus, high visibility

fonts.heading: Barlow Condensed
fonts.instructions: Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings (H1-H4) with tight tracking and uppercase styling for a heavy-weight athletic feel. Use 'DM Sans' for body text and numbers with increased tracking for legibility.

sections.header: Sticky header with user avatar, greeting, and high-level date/status.
sections.macros_dashboard: col-span-1 md:col-span-3 lg:col-span-2 row-span-2. Houses the main Calorie circular counter and a grid of 5 smaller circular counters for the other macros.
sections.ai_food_entry: col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-2 row-span-1. Textarea and submit button for AI processing.
sections.training_log: col-span-1 md:col-span-1 lg:col-span-1 row-span-1. Select and input form for workouts.
sections.daily_goals: Triggered via a button on the Macros Dashboard opening a Shadcn Dialog, or a separate card if space permits. A Dialog is preferred to save space.
sections.activity_feed: col-span-1 md:col-span-3 lg:col-span-4 row-span-1. A list showing today's logged food and training.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background bg-[#141414], 1px border border-[#2A2A2A], no shadow. Add subtle hover states (e.g., border-white/20). Rounded corners should be minimal, max 8px (rounded-md).
surfaces.buttons: High saturation blocks. Primary buttons should use #007AFF or #FF3B30 with white text. Rounded corners max 8px.
surfaces.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-[#2A2A2A] text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#007AFF] focus:border-[#007AFF].

circular_counters.description: Since Shadcn does not have a circular progress bar, the main agent MUST build a custom SVG component using <svg>, <circle>, and stroke-dasharray. The main Calories counter should be large (e.g., 200px), while the 5 macro counters should be smaller (e.g., 80px). Ensure they use the exact colors defined in 'colors.macros'.

ai_food_entry.description: Use Shadcn Textarea for natural language input (e.g., 'I ate 2 eggs and a banana'). Include a prominent 'Log Food' button. The AI integration should mock the OpenAI call returning a parsed JSON of macros, or implement it if possible. Highlight the mockup state.

training_log.description: Use Shadcn Select for the 8 default categories (Strength, Cardio, HIIT, Yoga, Swimming, Cycling, Running, Walking). Use Shadcn Input (type=number) for duration in minutes.

daily_goals_dialog.description: A modal dialog containing a form to update the target values for Calories, Protein, Fat, Carbs, Sugar, and Fiber.

motion_and_interactions.hover: All interactive elements MUST have a visible hover state with higher contrast (e.g., bg-[#2A2A2A] hover:bg-[#3A3A3A] hover:text-white).
motion_and_interactions.focus: Inputs and buttons must have a clear focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#007AFF]).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for buttons and cards.

images.description: Dark, confident athlete portrait used as the placeholder profile picture in the header.

icons.instructions: Use Lucide React for UI icons (e.g., Activity, Flame, Droplet, Dumbbell, Settings). Ensure icons use text colors corresponding to their context.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='log-food-button', data-testid='calorie-counter').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast against the #0A0A0A or #141414 backgrounds. Do not use fully transparent overlays over content.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required fonts: 'Barlow Condensed' and 'DM Sans' via Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
Configure tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors and fonts defined here.
Implement the Layout Strategy: 'Control Room' Grid with precise column spanning.

MOCK the OpenAI integration for food recognition if no backend is provided. Create a dummy service that simulates a 2-second delay and returns plausible macros based on the user's text. HIGHLIGHT THIS AS MOCKED in the UI or comments.
Build the Custom Circular Progress component using SVG. This is a hard requirement. Do not try to find it in Shadcn as it doesn't exist.
Ensure all 8 training categories are exactly as specified.
Implement local state or mock context to handle the Daily Goals and accumulating macros/training times so the dashboard is interactive and functional for a single session.
All cards must have a border and flat background; do not use heavy drop shadows.
